newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key June JGB futures fall one full point to 124.50.
newsitem.headline: Key June JGB futures fall one full point to 124.50.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract fell one full point to 124.50 in late morning Tokyo.
The June contract stood at 124.42 at 0153 GMT, after falling as low as 124.33. The futures slid after breaking through a key support point at 124.69, the June contract's low last week.
JGB futures were sold on stronger-than-expected rises in Tokyo stocks, traders said. The key 225-share Nikkei average surged more than three percent by late morning.
There was also market talk that foreigners were selling JGB futures while buying Nikkei 225 futures, they said. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
